definition: A gene is transient when its day1/day2 mean exceeds max(real training day0 mean, real training day3 mean) by the stated threshold.
scope: Absolute expression excess, across all selected genes; not just recall on retrospectively chosen positive markers.
reference: Real training endpoint means, held fixed for both true and generated transient calls.
note: Oracle and all-days training remain diagnostic; source feature discovery itself includes intermediate-day expression.
